name: YouTube Live
note: YouTube Live accepts RTMP ingest. Set in OBS → Settings → Stream.

instructions: 1. Go to YouTube Studio → Create → Go Live
2. Copy the Stream Key from the Live Control Room
3. Paste in OBS → Settings → Stream → Stream Key
5. Use obs-multi-rtmp plugin to stream to YouTube + Facebook simultaneously

regions.senegal: YouTube has Africa edge servers. Latency ~1-3s from Dakar.
regions.west_africa: Good coverage. Low latency from most West African capitals.
